# Code of conduct

This project adopts the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good intent, and keep discussions about the work. Harassment
or abuse of any kind is not tolerated.

Report unacceptable behavior privately to the maintainer through GitHub. Reports are handled confidentially.
